product_one_liner.value: Lob helps marketing, product and operations teams create, personalize, send and track automated direct-mail campaigns at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: Lob’s company-issued announcement describes an automated platform for personalized direct-mail programs at scale and specifically identifies marketing, product and operations teams as users: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/12/3186623/0/en/Lob-Strengthens-Executive-Leadership-Team-with-Appointments-of-CFO-CPO-and-CRO.html.

pricing_page.notes: Lob has a public pricing page displaying a starting price of $0 per month: https://www.lob.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Lob’s customer page explicitly describes 120Water and Included Health using its services: https://lob.com/customers. | named_customers.0: Lob’s customer page describes 120Water accelerating regulatory mail with Lob. | named_customers.1: Lob’s customer page explicitly states that Included Health uses automated direct mail.

employee_band.notes: Lob’s LinkedIn company profile reports a company size of 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/3231576.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Lob’s LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists San Francisco, California as its headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/3231576. | hq_country: The company profile explicitly locates Lob’s headquarters in San Francisco, United States: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/lob/__xJBMw-qXYC7ZeZ_oyZH99ovllMrbsaaGi8xEZpKub3g.

founded_year.notes: Lob’s Y Combinator profile explicitly states that it was founded in 2013: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lob.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering index lists separate technical articles about generating seven SDKs with OpenAPI and migrating Lob’s core API to Nomad. Their bodies describe internal developer-experience and infrastructure implementation work, rather than marketing. Article-page author-role metadata is incomplete, so confidence is medium. Sources: http://lob.com/category/engineering, http://lob.com/blog/how-we-used-openapi-to-write-7-sdks-in-a-year and http://lob.com/blog/nomad-migration.

public_docs.notes: The public help center links to multiple product guides, including launching a first campaign, the API quickstart and dynamic personalization: https://help.lob.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete live board lists five roles: Business Operations Manager, Corporate Counsel, Enterprise Account Executive, Partner Operations Manager and Senior Manager, USPS Programs. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/lob/jobs.

model_provider.value: Lob’s Postage Class Optimization and Return-to-Sender (RTS) Prediction models, publicly described as being tested.
model_provider.notes: Lob names these two models and expressly describes their use cases as being tested. The answer preserves that qualification rather than claiming production deployment or an external provider: https://lob.com/blog/how-lobs-machine-learning-models-aim-to-cut-cost-and-waste-in-direct-mail.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Lob’s Trust Center names SOC 2, HIPAA and GDPR, and describes its annual SOC 2 Type 2 audit. ISO 27001 and PCI DSS are not included in the reported list: https://trust.lob.com/. | compliance_certs.0: Lob explicitly describes its annual SOC 2 Type 2 audit. | compliance_certs.1: HIPAA is explicitly named in the Trust Center’s compliance list. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR is explicitly named in the Trust Center’s compliance list.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook explicitly labels the latest deal type as Debt and lists a completed Debt–General transaction. Other profiles identify February 2021 Series C as the latest dated round, creating some uncertainty; the debt date and amount remain undisclosed: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22. | funding_date: The latest reported debt transaction has no visible date in PitchBook’s funding table. February 2021 belongs to the Series C, not the undated debt: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22. | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook identifies a completed Debt–General transaction but leaves its amount blank. The $50 million figure disclosed for the older Series C cannot safely be assigned to this debt transaction: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22.

raised_18mo.notes: Timing is unresolved. The latest dated round is February 2021, outside the window, but PitchBook reports a latest debt transaction without a date. A reliable true or false cannot be assigned without dating that debt. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/58146-22 and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/lob/__xJBMw-qXYC7ZeZ_oyZH99ovllMrbsaaGi8xEZpKub3g.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Lob has a live Enterprise Account Executive posting, first published July 23, 2026: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/lob/jobs/8082143.

launched_6mo.notes: Lob introduced its No-Code Design Suite on August 31, 2026, within the six-month window. The announcement describes a substantial new workflow with visual editing, dynamic field mapping and templates: https://www.lob.com/blog/introducing-lobs-no-code-design-suite.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lob announced new executive appointments on November 12, 2025, within the twelve-month window, including David Pickel as CFO: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/11/12/3186623/0/en/lob-strengthens-executive-leadership-team-with-appointments-of-cfo-cpo-and-cro.html.
